mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, area_type AS area_type, name AS name FROM protected_area WHERE source = #{source}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO protected_area (name, area_type, source, source_date, boundary, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{area.name}, #{area.areaType}, #{area.source}, #{area.sourceDate}, ST_GeomFromText(#{area.boundaryWkt}, 4326, 'axis-order=long-lat'), #{now}, #{now})
